description: This file defines the Toolbar class for Drupal, providing a render element for the default Drupal toolbar, including methods for building and pre-rendering the toolbar, and accessing services like breakpoint manager and module handler.

classes.name: Toolbar
classes.description: Provides a render element for the Drupal toolbar, managing its rendering and behavior.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns configuration array for the toolbar render element, including pre-render callback, theme, attached libraries, and attributes.

methods.name: preRenderToolbar
methods.description: Prepares the toolbar element for rendering, including setting breakpoints, retrieving toolbar items via hook, sorting, and assigning IDs.
